blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: We introduce BOP-Refer, the first benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D grounding of everyday and industrial objects sourced from 9 diverse BOP datasets. We pair images from these datasets with VLM-generated and human-verified referring expressions, and derive accurate ground-truth 3D and 2D bounding boxes of the referred objects from their 3D models and 6DoF pose annotations. Our systematic evaluation of 17 frontier VLMs across the major proprietary and open-weight families (Gemini, GPT, Claude, Qwen, Gemma) shows that the best model, Gemini 4 Carbon, reaches 72.6% AP_IoU2D in 2D but only 12.4% AP_IoU3D in 3D, despite the more lenient IoU thresholds in 3D. The predicted 3D boxes are usually centered on the target objects in the image but often off in depth by more than the object's size, suggesting that metric scale estimation, which needs reliable object size priors, is currently by far the main source of error.
blocks.zh: 我们采用BOP-Refer,这是从9个不同的BOP数据集取自的日常和工业物体的单光三维和二维地平地的第一个基准. 我们将这些数据集的图像与VLM生成的和经人验证的引用表达式相配对,并从它们3D模型和6DOF中得出被引用物体的准确地-真实的3D和2D边框. 我们系统评估了17个前沿VLM, 跨越主要的专有和开放重量家庭(Gemini、GPT、Claude、Quen、Gemma), 所预测的3D框通常以图像中的目标对象为中心,但往往被深度超过对象大小而关闭,这表明需要可靠对象大小前身的度量尺度估计目前是出错的主要来源.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
3D object grounding, which is the task of 3D localization of objects referred to by a natural-language expression from visual or 3D input,
is important for systems that act in the physical world [ 16 , 1 ] .
Robots need 3D information for grasping, AR systems for augmenting objects with virtual content, and navigation systems for reaching named targets.
We focus on the monocular variant [ 99 ] , predicting 3D bounding boxes from a single image with known intrinsics rather than from the reconstructed point cloud assumed by most 3D grounding methods. This variant needs only a calibrated camera, as found on phones, robots, and AR/VR headsets.
blocks.zh:
3D对象搁浅,这是由视觉或3D输入的自然语言表达所指对象的3D本地化的任务,
对于在物理世界中发挥作用的系统来说,[16, 1]是重要的。
机器人需要3D信息来抓取,AR系统用于增强有虚拟内容的物体,以及导航系统来达到被命名的目标.
我们侧重于单相变体[99],从一个有已知内在的单一图像中预测出3D边框,而不是从大多数3D地基方法假设的重建点云中预测出. 这个变体只需要一个校正相机,如手机,机器人,以及AR/VR耳机上所发现的.

blocks.en:
While 2D grounding has been studied extensively, with task-specific detectors [ 58 , 68 ] and more recently general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs) [ 80 , 6 , 36 ] ,
the 3D counterpart remains underexplored. Three factors make it harder: (1) the expected output is an oriented 3D box rather than an axis-aligned rectangle, (2) ground truth is hard to obtain at scale, and (3) a single monocular view leaves object scale and distance jointly underdetermined.
Existing 3D grounding benchmarks focus on room-scale indoor or traffic scenes [ 16 , 1 , 99 , 48 ] , open-vocabulary 3D detectors are evaluated with category-level queries rather than free-form referring expressions [ 93 , 56 , 71 ] , and few evaluate 2D and 3D grounding together [ 23 , 27 ] , leaving it unclear whether errors arise in localizing the referred objects in the image or in estimating their 3D position, size, or orientation.
blocks.zh:
虽然已广泛研究了2D定位,但有特定任务的探测器[58、68]和最近的通用视觉语言模型[80、6、36],
3D对应方仍然没有得到充分利用。 三个因素使其更难: (1)预期输出是面向的3D框,而不是轴相通矩形; (2)地面真理很难在尺度上获得; (3)单相通的视图会留下物体尺度和相距共同被低估.
现有的3D地平面基准侧重于室内或交通场景[16, 1, 99, 48],开放式地平面3D探测器通过分类级查询而不是自由形式引用表达式[93, 56, 71]进行评价,很少评价2D和3D一起地平面[23, 27], 使得不清楚在图像中将被提及物体定位或估计其3D位置,大小或取向时是否出错.

blocks.en: To address these limitations, we introduce BOP-Refer, a benchmark for 3D and 2D object grounding built on top of BOP (Benchmark Object Pose) [ 52 , 75 ] , an established benchmark suite for 6DoF object pose estimation that includes a wide range of datasets with accurate 3D object models and pose annotations. Our key contributions are:
blocks.zh: 为解决这些局限性,我们引入了BOP-Refer,这是由BOP(Benchmark Object Pose)上方所建的3D和2D对象地基的基准[52,75],为6DOF对象所建的基准套件所构成的估算,包括了包含有精确3D对象模型的广泛数据集并提出了说明. 我们的主要贡献是:

blocks.en:
1. First benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D grounding of diverse objects from referring expressions. BOP-Refer covers 225 diverse everyday and industrial objects from 9 BOP datasets, with 1,400 validation and 1,400 test image-query pairs.
We provide VLM-generated, human-verified referring expressions (Fig. BOP-Refer: Benchmark for Monocular 3D and 2D Object Grounding ) with high-quality ground-truth 3D and 2D boxes, for direct comparison of 3D and 2D grounding on the same data. 2. Comprehensive evaluation of frontier VLMs. We evaluate 12 proprietary and 5 open-weight VLMs from the Gemini, GPT, Claude, Qwen, and Gemma families, revealing that monocular 3D grounding remains far from solved, whereas the strongest models already localize most referred objects well in 2D. Our analysis points to metric scale estimation (the distance and size of the objects) as the main source of error in 3D grounding. 3. Symmetry-aware 3D evaluation. We introduce two symmetry-aware 3D box comparison functions that treat symmetry-related 3D boxes as equivalent: a variant of the popular IoU3D , and NCD (Normalized Corner Distance), which can distinguish near and far misses. 4. Online evaluation system. We developed an online evaluation system that scores submissions on the test split with private ground-truth annotations and provides a public leaderboard of submitted methods. The validation split has public ground truth for development.

blocks.en: 2.1 2D grounding
blocks.zh: 2.1 二维地面

blocks.en: Classical 2D grounding benchmarks such as RefCOCO [ 60 ] , RefCOCO+ [ 96 ] , and RefCOCOg [ 72 ] , derived from MSCOCO [ 66 ] , pair each expression with a single region, whereas Flickr30k Entities [ 82 ] and gRefCOCO [ 67 , 30 ] also include multi-target expressions, as BOP-Refer does. Chen et al. [17] report labeling error rates of up to 24% in the RefCOCO family; BOP-Refer minimizes such errors by deriving ground truth from 3D object models in annotated 6DoF poses and by verifying every query by hand. Open-vocabulary detectors such as MDETR [ 58 ] , GLIP [ 62 ] , Grounding DINO [ 68 ] , and OWLv2 [ 74 ] , and general-purpose VLMs such as Kosmos-2 [ 80 ] , the Qwen-VL series [ 6 , 7 ] , Gemini [ 36 ] , and Molmo [ 28 ] predict 2D boxes or points from referring expressions. The strongest reach ∼ \sim 90% accuracy on RefCOCO, where scores are saturating [ 17 ] , motivating our harder monocular 3D setting.
blocks.zh: 经典的2D定位基准,如来自MSCOCO[66]的RefCOCO+[96]和RefCOCOg[72],将每个表达与单个区域对齐,而Flickr30k实体[82]和gRefCO[67,30]也包括多目标表达,如BOP-Refer所做的. 陈等. [17] 报告在RefCOCO家族中贴出最多为24%的标签错误率;BOP-Refer通过在注释 6DoF 中从 3D 对象模型中获取地面真相,并通过手验证每个查询,将这种错误降到最低。 MDETR [58],GLIP [62],地平地DINO [68],和OWLv2 [74]等开放式VLM探测器,以及通用VLM,如Kosmos-2 [80],Quen-VL系列 [6,7],双子座 [36],和Molmo [28] 从引用表达式中预测出2D盒或分. 最强者在RefCOCO上达到 \sim 90%的准确度, 得分在饱和 [17] , 激励我们更硬的单光谱 3D 设置。

blocks.en: 2.2 3D grounding
blocks.zh: 2.2 三维地面

blocks.en: ScanRefer [ 16 ] , ReferIt3D [ 1 ] , and the multi-target Multi3DRefer [ 102 ] ground expressions in reconstructed ScanNet [ 26 ] point clouds. The monocular setting is addressed by Mono3DRefer [ 99 ] , built on KITTI [ 32 ] with LLM-generated, human-verified queries, and by MM3DRefer and MT3DRefer [ 48 ] , which add multiple objects and the Rope3D [ 94 ] dataset (see also MonoMulti3D-ROPE [ 47 ] ). All match BOP-Refer’s setting: predicting a 3D box from a single image with known intrinsics and a referring expression. Of these, only Mono3DRefer is publicly available, making it BOP-Refer’s closest released counterpart (Tab. 1 ). BOP-Refer differs by covering everyday and industrial objects rather than driving scenes, unifying 2D and 3D evaluation, and deriving amodal ground truth from 3D object models in 6DoF poses rather than from LiDAR.
blocks.zh: 扫描参考 [16], ReferenceIt3D [1],以及重建的ScanNet [26]点云中的多目标多3Drefer [102]地表表达. 单体设置由Mono3Drefer[99]所处理,基于KITTI[32]所构建的由LLM所生成,经人验证的查询,由MM3Drefer和MT3Drefer[48]所处理,它们增加了多个对象和rope3D[94]数据集(也参见Mono Multile3D-ROPE[47]). 都符合 BOP- Refer 的设置: 从一个有已知内在和参考表达式的单一图像中预测出一个3D 框 。 其中只有Mono3DREFer公开提供,使其成为BOP-Refer最接近的发布对等数据(Tab. 1 ) 。 BOP-Refer在涵盖日常和工业物体而不是驱动场景,统一2D和3D评价,以及从6DOF中的3D物体模型而不是从LiDAR中得出模式地面真理方面有所不同。

blocks.en: Specialist models such as OVMono3D [ 93 ] , DetAny3D [ 100 ] , and WildDet3D [ 56 ] detect objects in 3D from category labels or 2D prompts, and LocateAnything3D [ 71 ] , a VLM-based detector that also supports grounding, is evaluated only with templated category and location prompts (e.g., “chair on the left”) rather than free-form referring expressions, all on Omni3D [ 12 ] , which has no per-object symmetry handling. Boxer [ 29 ] , SAM 3D [ 19 ] , and GR3D [ 21 ] lift 2D detections, masks, or grounded regions to 3D, and Oryon and Horyon [ 24 , 25 ] estimate a text-described object’s pose from two RGB-D views. Other 3D work, such as the Ego-Exo4D [ 44 ] correspondence task, ExCap3D [ 95 ] , Cubify Anything [ 61 ] , and SpatialLM [ 73 ] , does not ground free-form text to 3D boxes in a single image.
blocks.zh: 专家模型,如OVMONO3D [93],DetAny3D [100],和WildDet3D [56] 从分类标签或2D提示中检测到3D中的物体,以及Locent Anything3D [71],一个基于VLM的也支持地平线的探测器,只通过模板的分类和位置提示(如"左侧的椅子")来评价,而不是免费形式的引用表达,全部在Omni3D [12]上,没有进行逐个对象对称处理. Boxer [29], SAM 3D [19],以及GR3D [21] 将2D的检测,口罩,或被禁地区域提升到3D,而Oryon和Horyon [24,25] 从两个RGB-D角度估计出一个文字描述对象的姿势. 其他3D工作,如Ego-Exo4D [44] 通信任务,ExCap3D [95],Cubify Anything [61],和SpaceLM [73],不以一幅图像将自由格式文本打入3D盒.

blocks.en: 2.3 Spatial reasoning
blocks.zh: 2.3 空间推理

blocks.en: Beyond the grounding benchmarks above, spatial reasoning in VLMs is evaluated through visual question answering with text answers, e.g., by SpatialVLM [ 15 ] , 3DSRBench [ 70 ] , 3D-LLM [ 54 ] , and RoboSpatial [ 88 ] , or through 2D pointing at objects and regions, e.g., by PointArena [ 22 ] (spatial, affordance, and counting queries). SpatialRGPT [ 20 ] and Q-Spatial Bench [ 64 ] ask about metric distances and sizes, and the latter shows that reference objects of known size help VLMs. BOP-ASK [ 9 ] , also built on BOP datasets, provides 33M question-answer pairs for object-interaction reasoning, including referred-object poses. BOP-Refer instead targets text-to-box grounding with human-verified queries, 2D and 3D ground-truth boxes, and symmetry-aware metrics, which broad VLM benchmarks such as MMMU [ 97 ] , MMBench [ 69 ] , and MMStar [ 18 ] do not cover.
blocks.zh: 除了上述基准外,VLMs的空间推理是通过用文字回答的视觉问题回答来评价的,例如,SpaceVLM [15],3DSR Bench [70],3D-LLM [54],和RoboSpatial [88],或者通过2D指向物体和区域,例如,由PointArena [22](空间、支付和计数询问)来评价的。 SpaceRGPT [20]和Q-空间座座 [64] 询问测量距离和大小,后者显示已知大小的参考对象帮助了VLMs. BOP-ASK [9],也以BOP数据集为基础,为对象交互推理,包括被引用对象外观提供33M个问答对. 相反,BOP-Refer的目标是用经人验证的查询进行文本对框定位,2D和3D地面真实盒和对称感知度度量衡,MMMU [97],MMBench [69]等广义的VLM基准,MMStar [18]并不涵盖.

blocks.en: 2.4 Vision-language models
blocks.zh: 2.4 远景语言模式

blocks.en: Many recent VLMs output 2D bounding boxes or points: the Gemini family [ 35 , 38 ] , Gemini Robotics ER 2 [ 43 , 37 ] (a Gemini variant tuned for embodied reasoning), Claude Opus 4.6 and 4.7 [ 3 , 4 ] , Gemma 4 [ 34 ] , and the Qwen-VL family [ 7 ] document 2D boxes, and GPT-5.4 and 5.5 [ 76 , 77 ] return them when asked for pixel coordinates. A 3D box format is documented only for Gemini and for Qwen since Qwen3-VL, carried over to Qwen3.5 [ 84 ] and Qwen3.6 [ 85 ] . Their monocular 3D grounding remains largely untested: the few works that benchmark frontier closed VLMs on it cover one to three such models each, with category-level queries in room-scale scenes or referring expressions in driving scenes. Gemini Robotics [ 33 ] and the Seed1.5-VL [ 46 ] and Qwen3-VL [ 7 ] reports evaluate Gemini models on SUN-RGBD, MM-Spatial [ 27 ] evaluates GPT-4V and GPT-4o on indoor 3D grounding, and MonoVLM [ 83 ] and M3SunAgent [ 101 ] evaluate GPT-5 and Gemini 2.5 on Mono3DRefer [ 99 ] , where they trail specialized methods. Qwen3-VL is moreover trained on 3D data in Omni3D’s camera convention [ 12 ] , so its Omni3D results are in-distribution.
blocks.zh: 许多最近的VLMs输出了2D边框或点:双子座家族 [35,38],双子座机器人 ER 2 [43,37](双子座变体为被体现的推理), Claude Opus 4.6和4.7 [3, 4], Gemma 4 [34], 和 Quen-VL 家族 [7] 文件 2D 盒,以及 GPT 5.4 和 5.5 [76, 77] 要求像素坐标时返回. 3D盒格式仅为双子座和自Quen3-VL起为Quen所记录,后被结转至Quen3.5 [84]和Quen3.6 [85]. 它们的单相干3D地平面基本上仍未经过测试:作为基准线的几部作品关闭了其中的VLM,每部覆盖一到三个这样的模型,在房间尺度的场景中进行分类查询,或在驾驶场景中参考表达. 双子机器人[33]和种子1.5-VL [46]和Quen3-VL[7]报告评价双子模型在SUN-RGBD,MM-Spatial [27]评价了GPT-4V和GPT-4o在室内3D地平地上,而MonoVLM [83]和M3SunAgent [101]在Mono3Drefer[99]上评价了GPT-5和双子2.5,并追踪了专门的方法. Qwen3-VL在Omni3D的相机会展中接受了3D数据的培训[12],因此其Omni3D的结果是分散的.

blocks.en: 3 BOP-Refer benchmark
blocks.zh: 3 BOP-参考基准

blocks.en: This section defines the 3D and 2D grounding tasks and their metrics (Secs. 3.1 and 3.2 ), describes the source BOP datasets and the data splits (Sec. 3.3 ), and explains how the text queries are generated and human-verified (Sec. 3.4 ). Supp. Sec. F details how the ground-truth 3D and 2D bounding boxes are derived from the BOP annotations.
blocks.zh: 本节定义了3D和2D打地任务及其度量衡(Sec. 3.1和3.2),描述了源BOP数据集和数据分解(Sec. 3.3),并解释了文本查询是如何生成和人验证的(Sec.3.4.). 副警长 F详细介绍地真相3D和2D的边框是如何从BOP说明中衍生出来的.

blocks.en: 3.1 3D object grounding
blocks.zh: 3.1 三维物体搁浅

blocks.en:
Given a monocular image I I (RGB or monochrome) from a pinhole camera with known intrinsic matrix 𝐊 \mathbf{K} , and a text query q q referring to potentially multiple visible objects, the goal is to estimate oriented 3D bounding boxes { b 3 ​ D , i } i = 1 N \{b_{\mathrm{3D},i}\}_{i=1}^{N} of the referred objects.
Each 3D box is parameterized as b 3 ​ D , i = ( 𝐑 , 𝐭 , 𝐬 ) b_{\mathrm{3D},i}=(\mathbf{R},\mathbf{t},\mathbf{s}) , where ( 𝐑 , 𝐭 ) ∈ S ​ E ​ ( 3 ) (\mathbf{R},\mathbf{t})\in SE(3) is the rigid transformation from the box’s local frame B B (origin at the box center, axes aligned with the box edges) to the camera frame, and 𝐬 ∈ ℝ + 3 \mathbf{s}\in\mathbb{R}^{3}_{+} are the full extents along the three box axes. A point 𝐩 B \mathbf{p}_{B} expressed in B B thus maps to the camera frame as 𝐑 ​ 𝐩 B + 𝐭 \mathbf{R}\,\mathbf{p}_{B}+\mathbf{t} , and the 8 box corners are ( ± s x / 2 , ± s y / 2 , ± s z / 2 ) (\pm s_{x}/2,\pm s_{y}/2,\pm s_{z}/2) in B B . The bounding boxes

blocks.en: In practice, intrinsics are readily available in target deployment scenarios such as smartphones, robots, and AR/VR headsets. Geometrically, the focal length, object size, and distance are jointly unconstrained from a single view without intrinsics. Providing intrinsics resolves the focal length and leaves only the size-versus-distance ambiguity. The remaining problem is ill-posed but, we hypothesize, largely resolvable through learned priors about typical object sizes and scene layouts [ 98 ] that VLMs acquire from large-scale visual training data. Our error analysis shows that current VLMs do not yet resolve this ambiguity (Sec. 4.4 ).

blocks.en: 3.2 2D object grounding
blocks.zh: 3.2 二维物体搁浅

blocks.en: Given an image I I and a text query q q referring to one or more visible objects, the goal is to estimate their amodal 2D bounding boxes { b 2 ​ D , i } i = 1 N \{b_{\mathrm{2D},i}\}_{i=1}^{N} . Unlike in 3D, no camera intrinsics are given, as 2D boxes do not depend on them. Amodal means each box is the tightest axis-aligned rectangle around the whole object, including occluded parts. Each 2D box is b 2 ​ D , i = ( x 1 , y 1 , x 2 , y 2 ) b_{\mathrm{2D},i}=(x_{1},y_{1},x_{2},y_{2}) , its top-left and bottom-right corners in pixels.

Following COCO [ 66 ] , we use IoU2D thresholds τ ∈ { 0.50 , 0.55 , … , 0.95 } \tau\in\{0.50,0.55,\ldots,0.95\} and compute AP IoU2D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU2D}} as the average over the thresholds (per-threshold values in Supp. Tab. 11 ).

blocks.en: 3.3 Benchmark dataset
blocks.zh: 3.3 基准数据集

blocks.en:
BOP-Refer is built on 9 BOP datasets: six everyday-object datasets (HOT3D [ 8 ] , HANDAL [ 45 ] , HOPEv2 [ 89 ] , LM [ 49 ] , HB [ 59 ] , YCB-V [ 92 ] ) and three industrial-object datasets (T-LESS [ 51 ] , ITODD [ 31 ] , IPD [ 57 ] ), which together contain 227 unique objects, 225 of which are referred to by the BOP-Refer queries.
The datasets include accurate 3D object models and images of the objects in various scenes, annotated with 6DoF poses. We use the models and pose annotations to derive the ground-truth 3D and 2D bounding boxes (Supp. Sec. F ) and to generate the referring text queries (Sec. 3.4 ).
Fig. BOP-Refer: Benchmark for Monocular 3D and 2D Object Grounding shows sample images and queries from each dataset, and Supp. Tab. 15 lists per-dataset image counts and modality.
blocks.zh:
BOP-Refer以9个BOP数据集为基础:6个日常对象数据集(HOT3D [8],HANDAL [45],HOPEv2 [89],LM [49],HB [59],YCB-V [92])和3个工业对象数据集(T-LESS [51],ITODD [31],IPD [57])),共包含227个独特的对象,其中225个被BOP-Refer查询所提及.
数据集包括各种场景中对象的准确3D对象模型和图像,并附有6DoF外观的注释. 我们使用模型并作出说明,以得出地面真伪的3D和2D边框(Supp. Sec.F.)并生成参考文本查询(Sec.3.4.)。
图. BOP-Refer:单相机3D和2D对象定位基准显示每个数据集的样本图像和查询,并Supp. Tab. 15列出每个数据集的图像计数和模式.

blocks.en: Images are RGB, except in ITODD, IPD, and the Quest 3 subset of HOT3D, which are monochrome. Although some datasets include depth images, we use only 2D images to keep the input modality consistent. Fisheye images from HOT3D were undistorted to a pinhole model.
blocks.zh: 图像是RGB,除了ITODD,IPD,和HOT3D的Quest 3子集外都是单色. 虽然一些数据集包括了深度图像,但我们只使用2D图像来保持输入模式的一致性. HOT3D的鱼眼影像被分解成针孔模型.

blocks.en: Each sample consists of an image, camera intrinsics, a free-form natural-language query, and ground-truth 3D and 2D bounding boxes of the referred objects. A single query may refer to a single object (e.g., “the biggest mug”) or multiple objects (e.g., “all mugs on the table”). To support symmetry-aware evaluation, the ground-truth 3D bounding boxes are associated with discrete and continuous symmetry transformations of the objects.
blocks.zh: 每个样本包含一个图像,相机内在,自由形式的自然语言查询,以及被引用对象的地-实相3D和2D边框. 单一查询可以指单个对象(如"最大杯子")或多个对象(如"桌上的所有杯子"). 为了支持对称-认识评价,地真3D边框与物体的离散和连续对称变换有关.

blocks.en:
We provide validation and test splits, each containing 1,400 real images drawn from the 9 BOP datasets listed above, with one text query per image.
Ground-truth annotations are publicly available for the validation split but held private for the test split (accessible only through the online evaluation system).
We deliberately keep the splits compact to keep evaluation affordable even for large VLMs, and curate samples across datasets, query types, and target objects to ensure breadth. This matches popular grounding and VLM evaluation splits, which range from ∼ 900 {\sim}900 to ∼ 3,000 {\sim}3{,}000 samples (e.g., PointArena [ 22 ] , BOP-ASK [ 9 ] , MMMU [ 97 ] ,
MMBench [ 69 ] ).
blocks.zh:
我们提供验证和测试分解,每个分解包含从上述9个BOP数据集中提取的1400个真实图像,每个图像有一个文本查询.
现场真实情况说明是公开的,用于验证拆分,但用于测试拆分时是保密的(只能通过在线评价系统获取)。
我们刻意保持分数的紧凑,以保持评价的可承受性,即使是对大型VLM的可承受性,并对各种数据集、查询类型和目标对象的样本进行分类,以确保广度。 这符合流行的地基定位和VLM评价分数,从"900" {\ ("sim") 900到"3000" {\ ("sim") 3{, } 000个样本(如:PointArena [22], BOP-ASK [9], MMMU [97],
MMBench [69] (英语).

blocks.en:
BOP-Refer is an evaluation-only benchmark and by design does not provide any training split, leaving the choice of training data to each evaluated approach.
Training data can be generated by applying our query-generation pipeline (Sec. 3.4 , code in the BOP-Refer toolkit) to any images with 3D object annotations, e.g., the BOP training images of the same objects.
blocks.zh:
BOP-Refer是评价的唯一基准,从设计上讲,它不提供任何培训的分拆,而是将培训数据的选择留给每个被评价的方法。
培训数据可以通过将我们的查询生成管道(BOP-Refer工具包中的代码为3.4)应用到任何有3D对象说明的图像,例如相同对象的BOP训练图像来生成.

blocks.en: 3.4 Text query generation
blocks.zh: 3.4 国家 文本查询生成

blocks.en:
Text queries are generated by two VLMs (GPT-5.4 [ 76 ] and Gemini 3.1 Pro [ 39 ] ) to
reduce model-specific bias.
For each image, we first construct a scene graph that encodes object attributes and pairwise spatial relations. Object attributes include the normalized 2D bounding box, depth, visibility fraction, apparent- and physical-size ranks, and a human-readable position description. Pairwise relations cover direction, depth ordering, proximity, occlusion, support, and relative size, each qualified, where applicable, by a small, moderate, or large margin.
We also pre-generate an appearance description of each object with the two VLMs, from 8 canonical views rendered from its 3D model.
Each of the generator VLMs is then prompted with the image, the camera intrinsics, the scene graph in YAML form, and the object appearance descriptions, and is asked to select one or more target objects and produce 5 candidate referring expressions covering a mix of strategies (appearance, spatial-relational, comparative, functional, and multi-object).
Note that the generators receive strictly more information than the models being evaluated, which receive only the image, the query, and (in the 3D task) the camera intrinsics. Details are in Supp. Sec. G .
blocks.zh:
文本查询由两个VLM生成(GPT-5.4 [76]和双子座3.1 Pro [39])至
减少模型特定偏差。
对于每个图像,我们首先构建一个场景图,将对象属性和对等的空间关系编码. 对象属性包括正态的2D边框,深度,能见度分数,外观和物理大小的排列,以及可被人读取的位置描述. 对等关系包括方向、深度命令、相近、隔离、支持和相对大小,在适用的情况下,每个关系都以小、中或大幅度限定。
我们还从从从3D模型中得出的8个犬形观点中,用两个VLM预生出每个物体的外观描述.
每个生成器VLM随即被以图像,相机内在,以YAML形式显示的场景图,以及对象外观描述来提示,并被要求选择一个或多个目标对象,并产生5个候选的推荐表达式,涵盖各种策略的组合(出现,空间关系,比较,功能,多对象).

blocks.en:
Generated queries went through two filtering stages: (1) automatic verification, where Claude Opus 4.7 checked each query against 14 criteria, including unambiguity, and rejected it if any failed,
and (2) human verification, where 25 recruited reviewers inspected the remaining queries in a dedicated tool and rewrote or discarded those still judged incorrect or ambiguous. Finally, one query per image was kept, balancing object coverage and including multi-target queries.
Automatic verification keeps 49 to 71% of the 21,190 candidate test queries, depending on the source dataset, and the human reviewers accept at least one query for 81% of the inspected samples (Supp. Secs. G.2 and G.3 ).

生成的查询经过了两个过滤阶段:(1) 自动核查,Claude Opus 4.7对照14个标准检查每个查询,包括不矛盾,如果有任何失败,则予以拒绝,
和(2) 人力核查,其中25名被征聘的审查人员在一个专门的工具中检查了其余的询问,并改写或抛弃了那些仍然被认为不正确或模棱两可的询问。 最后,每个图像都保留了一个查询,平衡了对象覆盖,并包括了多目标查询.
根据来源数据集,自动核查保留了21,190个候选测试询问中的49%至71%,人类审查员至少接受对81%被检查样本的查询(Supp. Secs. G.2和G.3)。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4个实验

blocks.en:
We evaluate a diverse set of state-of-the-art VLMs from the Gemini, GPT, Claude, Qwen, and Gemma families, alongside four specialist 3D grounding pipelines (WildDet3D, Boxer, SAM 3D, and mask back-projection).
No model is fine-tuned on the benchmark.
We report test-split results here and validation-split results in Supp. Sec. C . Three key ablations are in Sec. 4.3 , and further ones in Supp. Sec. A .

基准上没有任何模型经过微调。

We evaluate 12 proprietary and 5 open-weight models. The proprietary ones are Gemini Robotics ER 2 [ 43 ] , four more Gemini models (3.1 Pro [ 39 ] , 3.8 Flash [ 40 ] , 4 Argon [ 41 ] , and 4 Carbon [ 42 ] ), four GPT models (5.4 and 5.5 [ 76 , 77 ] , 6 Astra [ 79 ] , and 6.1 Sol [ 78 ] ), and three Claude models (Opus 4.6 [ 3 ] , 4.7 [ 4 ] , and 5.5 [ 5 ] ), all of which output 2D boxes (Sec. 2.4 ).
The open-weight ones are three successive Qwen releases with native 2D box prediction, Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B [ 7 ] and its natively multimodal successors Qwen3.5-397B-A17B [ 84 ] and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B [ 85 ] , as well as Qwen3.8-Flash-Next [ 86 ] , an open-weight preview of the architecture planned for Qwen4 (125B parameters, 6B active), and Gemma 4 31B [ 34 ] .
Each model is evaluated 3 times on both tasks
with the same inputs and settings in every run. We report the mean and standard deviation over these runs in all result tables.

Each VLM receives the image, the text query, and a specification of the output format. In 2D, each family receives its documented prompt and box format where one exists; GPT, which documents none, receives a prompt similar to Claude’s. In 3D, all models receive the same prompt, our own: it asks for the 9-DoF box format published for Gemini and Qwen (center, size, and roll/pitch/yaw angles), provides the camera intrinsics,
and includes 5 text-only in-context examples. Proprietary models run at medium reasoning effort, and Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, and Qwen3.8 Flash Next with thinking on, except Qwen3.6 in 3D, where 62% of its answers hit the output cap even when raised from 16K to 32K tokens.

We tried various prompts on the validation split and kept the elements with a clear effect on the scores: the camera intrinsics and the in-context examples, which improve format following for some models (Supp. Sec. blocks.en:
Beyond end-to-end VLMs, we evaluate four additional 3D grounding methods, most in several variants.
First, WildDet3D [ 56 ] is a promptable monocular 3D detector that can accept a text or 2D box/point prompt, and optionally a depth map. We evaluate it with its own SAM 3-based 2D detection [ 14 ] or ground-truth 2D boxes, and with no depth map, the sensor depth map, or one predicted by Depth Anything 3 (DA3) [ 65 ] or UniDepthV2 [ 81 ] .
Second, Boxer [ 29 ] lifts a 2D bounding box to a 3D box, using the whole image and, optionally, 3D scene points. We evaluate it in the same settings as WildDet3D, with the gravity direction of each image estimated by GeoCalib [ 90 ] (Supp. Sec. J.2 ).
Third, SAM 3D [ 19 ] reconstructs the 3D shape, pose, and texture of an object from an image and a 2D mask. It outputs no 3D box, so we take the axis-aligned box of the reconstructed mesh in its canonical frame, placed into the camera by the predicted pose and scale (Supp. Sec. J.3 ). Fourth, mask back-projection lifts the SAM 3 mask [ 14 ] of each Gemini 4 Carbon 2D box with Depth Pro 2 (DP2) depth [ 55 ] and fits a box (Supp. Sec. J.4 ). Like the VLMs, each variant is run 3 times (mask back-projection once).
blocks.zh:
除了从端到端的VLM外,我们评价了另外四种三维地基方法,大多数是几种变体.
首先,WildDet3D [56]是一款能被迅速接收到文本或2D盒/点提示的单相机3D探测器,并且可选取深度图. 我们用自己的SAM 三基二维探测 [14] 或地真二维相框来评价它,没有深度图,传感器深度图,或者由深度Anything 3(DA3) [65] 或 Uni DepthV2 [81] 预言的.
第二,"拳击手" [29] 将一个2D边框提升到一个3D框上,使用整个图像,以及可选的3D场景点. 我们用与WildDet3D相同的环境来评价它,并按GeoCalib[90](Supp. Sec.J.2.)估计出每个图像的重力方向.
第三,SAM 3D [19]从图像和2D口罩重建出一个物体的3D形状,姿势和纹理. 它不输出3D框,所以我们取出由预测的姿势和尺度放入相机的被重建的网格的轴相接箱(Supp. Sec. J.3). 第四,口罩后投影可以举起每个双子座4碳2D箱的SAM 3口罩[14],并有深度Pro 2 (DP2)深度[55]并合用一箱(Supp. Sec. J.4. 与VLMs一样,每个变体运行了3次(一次任务后投放).

blocks.en: Monocular 3D grounding is far from solved. The best VLM, Gemini 4 Carbon, reaches only 12.4% AP IoU3D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU3D}} and the next best, Claude Opus 5.5, 5.3% (Supp. Tab. 6 ), while the dedicated 3D pipelines WildDet3D and Boxer (run with SAM 3-based detection and Depth Anything 3 depth) score 1.6% and 1.0%. Mask back-projection (Carbon2D + SAM 3 + DP2), which lifts Carbon’s 2D boxes with predicted depth, reaches 7.3%, second only to Carbon’s own 3D boxes. At such low scores, AP IoU3D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU3D}} says little about how close the predictions come, as a complete miss and a box off by a few centimeters both score zero. AP NCD \text{AP}_{\text{NCD}} (Tab. 2 ) separates them: it spreads the VLMs from 13.9% to 60.3%, the 12 VLMs below 2% AP IoU3D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU3D}} alone from 13.9% to 32.5%, and ranks them consistently with AP IoU3D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU3D}} (Spearman’s ρ = 0.96 \rho=0.96 ).

Gemini 4 Carbon leads with 72.6% AP IoU2D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU2D}} , ahead of Gemini 4 Argon (69.1%) and Claude Opus 5.5 (69.0%), 0.1 points apart and within the run-to-run standard deviation (at most 0.6 0.6 points). For Claude and GPT, the generational gains are even larger in 2D: AP IoU2D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU2D}} grows from 1.3% for Claude Opus 4.6 to 18.8% for Opus 4.7 and 69.0% for Opus 5.5, and from 4.6% for GPT-5.4 to 25.2% for GPT-5.5 and 65.5% for GPT-6 Astra. blocks.en: VLMs localize the referred objects far better in 2D than in 3D: Gemini 4 Carbon reaches 72.6% AP IoU2D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU2D}} but only 12.4% AP IoU3D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU3D}} on the same images and queries (Tab. 3 and Supp. Tab. 6 ). To find where 3D grounding fails, we ran a range of ablations. Those on query cardinality, target visibility and size, camera intrinsics, few-shot prompting, and output representation are in Supp. Sec. A , and the three that stood out are reported here. Supp. Tab. 4 lists the VLM ablations, and Supp. Tabs. 7 and 8 the specialist pipelines given ground-truth 2D boxes. Each gives the method one piece of ground-truth information that it otherwise has to estimate: the distances between the camera center and the centers of the target objects, the targets’ 2D boxes, or a depth map of the scene. Each ablation is run on the methods that natively accept its input. The distance and 2D-box ablations are run on three strong VLMs, one per lab (Gemini 4 Carbon, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Astra), the 2D-box ablation also on WildDet3D, Boxer, and SAM 3D, and the depth ablation on WildDet3D and Boxer.

blocks.en: 4.4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.4 讨论情况

blocks.en: The models usually find the referred objects but often misjudge their metric scale. For Gemini 4 Carbon, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Astra, we pair each ground-truth box with the predicted box whose center is closest in the image (single-target test queries, Supp. Sec. A.3 ). The predicted centers lie in almost exactly the right direction from the camera (median error at most 0.6 ∘ ), but the boxes have median errors of 7 to 18% in distance and 7 to 15% in size, errors coupled by the size-distance ambiguity of a single view. Such errors are costly in 3D: for the median object, an 8 cm cube at 78 cm, even a correctly sized and oriented box needs a distance error below 6.3% to reach IoU3D ≥ 0.25 \text{IoU3D}\geq 0.25 , which holds for only 20% (GPT-6 Astra) to 45% (Gemini 4 Carbon) of the predictions. Over all queries, their 2D boxes miss only 1 to 2% of the targets, but their 3D boxes miss 35 to 62%. This is why the ground-truth distance or a depth map helps far more than the ground-truth 2D box (Sec. 4.3 ). Even given the distance, AP IoU3D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU3D}} stays at 50 to 60%, so size and orientation are hard to estimate too.

blocks.en: The low AP IoU3D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU3D}} scores raise the question of whether precise monocular 3D grounding is tractable. Existing benchmarks suggest that it is for methods trained for the test setting: specialized models trained on the driving scenes of Mono3DRefer [ 99 ] and models trained on Omni3D [ 12 ] , including Qwen3-VL, reach high accuracy on these benchmarks (Supp. Sec. K ). None of the models evaluated in this paper was trained for BOP-Refer, whose objects, sizes, distances, and viewpoints differ from those benchmarks, and all of the models score low. We therefore expect the scores to improve in two ways: with training data closer to the BOP-Refer setting, and with VLMs that learn stronger general priors on object size.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented BOP-Refer, a benchmark for monocular 3D and 2D object grounding.
Built on 9 diverse BOP datasets, the benchmark pairs VLM-generated, human-verified referring expressions with accurate ground-truth boxes derived from 3D object models in annotated 6DoF poses. Our evaluation of 17 frontier VLMs shows that monocular 3D grounding remains a major open challenge, whereas the strongest models already localize most referred objects well in 2D. Most 3D failures thus come not from finding the referred objects but from estimating their metric distance and size, and giving the models the targets’ distances brings by far the largest gains. As a single view constrains only the ratio of size to distance, an important direction for future work is to equip VLMs with stronger priors on the physical size of objects and the ability to infer it from context, e.g., from nearby objects of known size [ 64 ] .
Our query-generation pipeline applies to any images with 3D object annotations, so it can also produce matching training data, e.g., from the BOP training images, and extend BOP-Refer beyond the BOP objects in future editions. The 3D object models could also enable text-to-shape tasks.
We hope BOP-Refer will help drive progress on 3D reasoning in VLMs.

blocks.en: We developed the 3D prompt on the validation split with several VLMs and kept the elements with a clear effect on the scores (Sec. 4.1 ). Beyond the 9-DoF JSON format of our 3D prompt, which only Qwen and Gemini document as their native 3D box format, we tried other output formats, including Spatial Cookbook–style prompts [ 36 ] that place intermediate 2D anchors before the 3D box. None scored noticeably better, so the low scores do not appear to be an artifact of the output representation. The camera intrinsics helped some of the models, and the text-only in-context examples mainly improved format following: for one model, they raised the share of parsable answers from about 75% to 97% and fixed its camera-frame and unit conventions, whereas another parsed about 97% even without them.

blocks.en: A.6 Query-generator bias
blocks.zh: A.6 查询生成器偏差

blocks.en: Because the referring expressions are written by VLMs (GPT-5.4 and Gemini 3.1 Pro), a model might be favored by queries its own family generated. The generators produce only text: the ground-truth boxes come from the 3D object models and 6DoF pose annotations, so no information about the answer can leak through a query, and any advantage would have to come from familiarity with the phrasing. We see no sign of such an advantage for the generators themselves. In 3D, GPT-5.4 and Gemini 3.1 Pro reach only 24.5% and 24.6% AP NCD \text{AP}_{\text{NCD}} , less than half the score of the best model (60.3%, Gemini 4 Carbon). In 2D, GPT-5.4 reaches only 4.6% AP IoU2D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU2D}} , and Gemini 3.1 Pro (61.0%) trails Claude Opus 5.5 (69.0%), whose family generated no queries. Every query was also checked by an independent verifier (Claude Opus 4.7) and by human reviewers, who rewrote or discarded a large share of the candidates, which further dilutes the style of any single generator.
blocks.zh: 由于引用的表达式由VLMs(GPT-5.4和双子座3.1 Pro)所写出,因此一个模型可能会通过自己产生家族的查询而获得青睐. 生成器只产生文字:地真盒出自3D对象模型,而6DoF则会提出说明,因此任何关于答案的信息都不能通过查询泄露出,任何优点都得出自对用词的熟悉. 我们没有看到对发电机本身有这种优势的迹象。 在3D中,GPT-5.4和双子座3.1 Pro只达到24.5%和24.6%的AP NCD\text{AP}_{\text{NCD}}},还不到最佳模型得分的一半(60.3%,双子座4 Carbon). 在2D中,GPT-5.4只达到4.6%的AP IoU2D\text{AP}_{\QText{IoU2D}};双子座3.1 Pro (61.0%)追逐克洛德·奥普斯 5.5 (69.0%),其家族没有产生询问. 每个查询也都经过了独立核查员(Claude Opus 4.7)和人文审查员的检查,他们重编或丢弃了很大一部分候选人,这进一步淡化了任何单一生成器的风格.

blocks.en: The most common 3D failure is the one the projections hide: the predicted box overlaps the target in the image but is off in distance and size, which moves and scales the box along the viewing rays and barely changes its projection. On the test split, the 2D boxes enclosing the projected predicted and ground-truth 3D boxes have an IoU of at least 0.5 for 88%, 83%, and 94% of the queries (first run of Gemini 4 Carbon, Claude Opus 5.5, and GPT-6 Astra), yet IoU3D stays below 0.25 for 72 to 89% of them. The NCD and IoU3D values in the figures expose such misses, e.g., for the ITODD query “the top cap”, the projected box of Claude Opus 5.5 nearly coincides with the ground truth, but its NCD is 4.0 and IoU3D 0. Boxing a clearly different object (an IoU of the enclosing 2D boxes below 0.2) is rarer: 2.5%, 2.4%, and 1.6% of the test queries, e.g., GPT-6 Astra for the T-LESS query “the widest of the socket holders on top of the book”. For the HB query “all the objects placed on the blue surface”, Opus 5.5 and Astra box all five targets, but even their closest boxes have IoU3D 0.00 and 0.04.

The graph is serialized as YAML and given to the query generator as text alongside the image. Spatial relations are computed from the 6DoF poses rather than being inferred by a model, and the generator is instructed to treat the graph as the sole source of truth for any spatial claim. blocks.en: The generator receives the image, the camera intrinsics, the scene graph, and the object descriptions, and is asked for 5 candidate queries spanning different referring strategies. It is told explicitly that the evaluated model will see only the image, the intrinsics, and the query. Abbreviated template:

blocks.en: You are generating text queries for a vision benchmark that evaluates language-grounded object localization. Each query will be paired with the attached image and camera intrinsics. blocks.en: The surviving candidates were inspected by 25 human reviewers in a web tool that shows each candidate under its image, with the targets highlighted by red boxes, and lets the reviewer accept the query, rewrite it, or flag the sample as unusable. Reviewers saw 3,347 test samples, where a sample is one image with its candidate queries. For 2,714 samples (81%), the reviewers accepted at least one query as generated, and for 356 (11%), they rewrote a query and kept the rewrite. The remaining 277 samples (8%) were flagged unusable and dropped. A sample was flagged unusable only when no rewrite could produce a sound query, typically because the target is almost fully occluded, only a few pixels across, or too dark or blurred to identify.

blocks.en: A diversity-trimming step then capped each query specification at 1.3 × 1.3\times the mean occurrence, removing 242 over-represented queries. The final selection covers the objects of each dataset nearly uniformly (the normalized entropy of the number of queries per object is 0.88 to 0.99 in every dataset of both splits) and spreads the images evenly over the scenes, except in LM and HOPEv2, where one scene contributes a larger share of the images. blocks.en: I.4 Output parsing
blocks.zh: I.4 产出分析

blocks.en: All responses go through a shared parser. It keeps the text after the last “Final Answer:” tag if there is one, strips markdown code fences, and parses the rest as JSON, falling back to the first balanced JSON array or object if that fails. Predictions that still fail to parse count as zero detections. For Gemini 4 Carbon and Gemini Robotics ER 2, calls that return no answer, typically because thinking used up the token budget, are re-sampled up to 5 times (ER 2 also when cut off). This yields an answer for about 22% of Carbon’s 3D test queries, and the roughly 6% still without one after 5 re-samples count as misses, so its 3D scores are slightly underestimated. ER 2 needed this for at most one query per run, and the other models, which are not re-sampled, rarely return empty answers (GPT-5.5: about 5%).

To catch unit errors, a box whose center coordinates are all below 20 in magnitude is read as meters, and otherwise as millimeters. Angles are read as degrees. Following the official Qwen 3D grounding cookbook [ 7 ] , the Qwen 3D boxes are read as metric boxes in the camera frame, since applying the Omni3D virtual-camera depth denormalization [ 12 ] instead degraded their scores. blocks.en: Appendix J Other 3D grounding methods
blocks.zh: 附录J 其他立体定位方法

blocks.en: This section describes how the other 3D grounding methods in Tabs. 2 , 6 , 7 , and 8 are implemented. They use public checkpoints without fine-tuning (mask back-projection also uses Gemini 4 Carbon) and run on every test image with its camera intrinsics. The rows fall into two groups. In Tabs. 2 and 6 , the referred objects are localized from the text query alone: WildDet3D uses its own text-grounded 2D head, which is built on SAM 3 [ 14 ] , while Boxer and SAM 3D use 2D boxes and masks predicted by SAM 3 (Sec. J.5 ), and mask back-projection uses the 2D boxes of Gemini 4 Carbon (Sec. J.4 ). In Tabs. 7 and 8 , each method instead receives one prompt per ground-truth 2D box of the query’s target objects, which factors out 2D detection errors. WildDet3D and Boxer without depth are deterministic, whereas the Boxer rows with depth and SAM 3D vary slightly across runs because of the random sampling of points and seeds (Sec. J.2 ).

blocks.en: J.1 WildDet3D
blocks.zh: J.1 荒地3D

blocks.en: WildDet3D [ 56 ] is a promptable monocular 3D detector. It takes an RGB image, the intrinsic matrix 𝐊 \mathbf{K} , an optional dense depth map, and a text, 2D-box, or 2D-point prompt, and returns a 2D box and a 9-DoF 3D box per detected object in the camera frame. Every image is fitted into a 1008 × 1008 1008\times 1008 canvas (the longer side resized to 1008 pixels, the shorter side zero-padded, and the intrinsics and box prompts transformed accordingly), and non-maximum suppression is applied at IoU 0.6 0.6 .
blocks.zh: WildDet3D [56] 是一款可被迅速发射的单发三维探测器. 它需要一个RGB图像,内在矩阵 K\ mathbf{K},一个可选的密集深度图,和一个文本,2D-box,或2D-点提示,然后返回相机框中每个被检测对象一个2D盒和一个9-DoF 3D盒. 每个图像被装入一个1008×10081008\times 1008画布(更长的侧面被调整为1008像素,更短的侧面零加成,内在和框的提示被相应转换出),在IoU 0.6 0.6中应用了非最大压制.

blocks.en: In Tabs. 2 and 6 , WildDet3D runs in its native text-prompt mode: the benchmark query is passed as the input text, the internal text-grounded 2D head proposes the objects, and all 3D candidates with a score of at least 0.3 0.3 (the upstream default) are kept as predictions. The four rows using ground-truth 2D detections run WildDet3D in box-prompt mode. Each ground-truth 2D box is passed as a separate prompt together with the generic text label object , which scored better than the upstream default label geometric: object and the full query. The score threshold is lowered to 0 0 so that every prompt returns a candidate, and the best candidate of each prompt is kept.
blocks.zh: 在 Tabs. 2 和 6 中, WildDet3 D以原生的文本-即时模式运行:基准查询作为输入文本被通过,内部以文本定位的2D头提出对象,所有得分至少为0.3分的3D候选人(上游默认)被保留为预测. 使用地真2D探测器的四行以箱快取模式运行了WildDet3D. 每个地真2D框与通用文本标签对象一起作为单独的提示被传递,后者的得分优于上游默认标签几何:对象和完整查询. 得分门槛被降低到0分,以便每一次迅速返回一名候选人,每一次迅速返回的最佳候选人都保持不变.

blocks.en: The rows differ in the depth map passed to WildDet3D: none (the monocular geometry head is used), depth predicted by Depth Anything 3 (DA3) or UniDepthV2 [ 81 ] (Sec. J.5 ), or the real sensor depth provided with the images. Depth maps are resampled into the canvas with nearest-neighbour interpolation, which avoids blending foreground and background depths at object silhouettes. HOT3D, HANDAL, and IPD provide no dense depth, so the sensor-depth rows of WildDet3D and Boxer are reported as -- on these datasets and without an overall score.
blocks.zh: 各行在传递到WildDet3D的深度图上有所不同:无一(使用单相位几何头),由深度Anything 3 (DA3)或 Uni DepthV2 [81] (Sec. J.5)所预测的深度,或由图像提供的真实的传感器深度. 深度图被用相距最近的相邻插入来再被复制到画布中,这避免了在对象 silhouettes上将前地和后地深度相混合. HOT3D,HANDAL,和IPD提供不密集的深度,因此"WildDet3D"和"Boxer"的感光深度一行被报告为 -- 在这些数据集上,没有总体分数.

blocks.en: The depth map is passed in meters with depth input enabled, as the WildDet3D README specifies, and WildDet3D does use it: the median ratio of predicted to true object distance falls from 1.21–4.49 per dataset without depth to 1.09–1.89 with sensor depth. It still places objects too far, whereas Boxer, given the same depth maps, is within 3% of the true distance on every dataset. This matches how WildDet3D is trained: 70% of its training samples have no depth input, 20% a patch-masked depth map, and only 10% the full depth map [ 56 , Sec. 2.1] .
blocks.zh: 如WildDet3D README所指定,深度图以米为单位通过,而WildDet3D确实使用:预测到真实对象距离的中位比从每套没有深度的 1.21–4.49下降到传感器深度的 1.09–1.89。 它仍然将物体放置得太远,而Boxer,由于同样的深度地图,在每个数据集中,它都在真实距离的3%以内. 这与WildDet3D的训练方式相符:其训练样本有70%没有深度输入,有20%是补丁-厚度深度图,只有10%是全深度图[56, Sec. 2.1].

blocks.en: J.2 Boxer
blocks.zh: J.2 拳击手

blocks.en: Boxer [ 29 ] detects objects with an open-vocabulary 2D detector and lifts each 2D detection to an oriented 3D box with a transformer called BoxerNet. We use the official release v1.0.0 (tag ef6cad8 ) with the public boxernet_hw960in2x6d768-c88128f8.ckpt checkpoint and bypass the built-in 2D detector: BoxerNet receives either every SAM 3 box of the query with a score of at least 0.3 0.3 , the same boxes as SAM 3D (Tabs. 2 and 6 , where queries for which SAM 3 returns no such box get no prediction) or each ground-truth 2D box as a separate prompt (Tabs. 7 and 8 ). The image is resized to 960 × 960 960\times 960 with correspondingly rescaled intrinsics, and the predictions are mapped back to the original image.
blocks.zh: Boxer [29] 探测出带有开口道2D探测器的物体,并将每个2D探测器提升到有变压器名为BoxerNet的向外的3D盒上. 我们使用官方发布 v1.0.0 (tag ef6cad8 ) 与公共拳击网_hw960in2x6d768-c88128f8.ckpt 检查站并绕过内置的2D探测器: BoxerNet收到至少0.3 0.3分的每个SAM 3个查询框,与SAM 3D(Tababs. 2和6,其中SAM 3返回的查询不会得到这样的预测)相同,或每个地真相2D盒作为单独的快取(Tababs. 7和8). 图像被调整为960×960 960\times 960,并对应地被调整了内在的分级,预测被映射回了原始图像.

blocks.en: Boxer is designed for video with known per-frame camera poses and a semi-dense point cloud. Its README also covers single images given the camera intrinsics and the direction of gravity, and lists only images without this information as untested. BoxerNet regresses gravity-aligned boxes, so it needs the direction of gravity in the camera frame. Since many BOP-Refer views are tilted, we estimate the gravity direction of each image with GeoCalib [ 90 ] , as the Boxer authors suggest for inputs without known gravity, and set the camera pose passed to Boxer accordingly. The rows without depth pass an empty point cloud. In the rows with depth ( + DA3 , + UniDepthV2 , and + sensor depth ), the depth map, the same as for WildDet3D, is back-projected into a 3D point cloud with the camera intrinsics, and 10,000 points sampled from it at random, with a new seed per run, are passed as Boxer’s point input.
blocks.zh: 博克特设计用于有已知的每帧相机姿势和半密集点云的视频. 其README还覆盖了考虑到相机内在和重力方向的单个图像,并仅将没有这些信息的图像列为未经测试. BoxerNet倒置出重力相通的相框,所以它需要相机相框中重力的方向. 由于许多BOP-Refer视图是倾斜的,我们用GeoCalib [90] 来估计每个图像的重力方向,正如Boxer作者建议输入而无已知重力,并设定相机姿势相应传递给Boxer. 无入深行通一空分云. 在有深度的行(+ DA3,+ Uni DepthV2,并+传感器深度)中,深度图与WildDet3D相同后被反投射入相机内含的3D点云中,从中随机抽取出一万分,每跑有一新种子,作为Boxer的点入.

blocks.en: SAM 3D [ 19 ] is a generative single-image 3D object reconstructor. From an RGB image and a binary object mask, it produces a textured mesh of the object in a canonical frame, with a 6DoF pose and an isotropic scale that place the mesh into the camera. We use the released checkpoints/hf/pipeline.yaml configuration. It uses neither the camera intrinsics nor a depth map, so it infers the distance and scale of the object from the image alone, without any metric reference.
blocks.zh: SAM 3D [19]是一款基因单相相相的3D对象重建器. 它从一个RGB图像和一个二进制对象口罩中,产生一个有纹理的网格,在犬形框架内,有6DOF的外观和将网格放入相机的同位素尺度. 我们使用放行的检查站/hf/管道。 雅姆尔配置。 它既不使用相机内在的相机,也不使用深度图,因此它从图像中单独推断出物体的相距和相距,没有任何公尺参考.

blocks.en: In Tabs. 2 and 6 , every mask that SAM 3 returns for the query with a score of at least 0.3 0.3 is lifted to a separate prediction, and queries without such a mask get no prediction. In Tabs. 7 and 8 , each ground-truth 2D box is rasterized into a rectangular mask at the original image resolution.
blocks.zh: 在"Tabs. 2"和"6"中,SAM 3为查询返回的至少0.3分的每个口罩被解除为单独的预测,没有这样的口罩的询问不会得到预测. 在 Tabs. 7和8中,每个地真2D盒被光栅化成一长方形的面具,在原始图像分辨率下.

blocks.en: SAM 3D outputs no 3D box, so we take the axis-aligned box of the reconstructed mesh in its canonical frame: its extents are the per-axis ranges of the mesh vertices multiplied by the predicted scale, and it is placed into the camera by the predicted pose, converted from the PyTorch3D to the OpenCV camera convention by a 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} rotation about the optical axis. Its center is the predicted translation, i.e., the center of SAM 3D’s canonical cube, which need not coincide with the center of the mesh. The canonical frame is gravity-aligned and unrelated to the oriented-box frame that BOP-Refer fits to each object model (Supp. Sec. F ), so its axes and center can differ from the ground truth even for a perfect reconstruction. The SAM 3D scores therefore measure this canonical-box approximation rather than the quality of the reconstruction.

blocks.en: J.4 Mask back-projection
blocks.zh: 第4页 遮盖后投影

blocks.en: This baseline combines VLM grounding, object masks, and monocular metric depth: Gemini 4 Carbon localizes the referred objects in 2D, and the mask of the object in each 2D box is back-projected to 3D with a predicted depth map. The 2D boxes come from one of Carbon’s three default 2D test runs (1,800 boxes for the 1,400 queries), and each box yields one 3D box with the box’s confidence, derived from its position in Carbon’s answer (Sec. I.4 ). It uses no ground truth at test time and is run once.
blocks.zh: 这个基线结合了VLM地平面,物体口罩,和单相位度量深度:双子座4碳将被指的物体定位为2D,每个2D盒中物体口罩被反向投射为3D并有预测深度图. 2D盒来自Carbon三次默认的2D测试运行(1,400个查询的1,800个盒)之一,每个盒产生一个有该盒信心的3D盒,取自其在Carbon答案中的位置(Sec. I.4 ). 它在测试时没有使用地面真理,并且运行一次.

blocks.en: SAM 3 [ 14 ] computes the masks, prompted with each Carbon box rather than with the text query as for Boxer and SAM 3D (Sec. J.5 ), and the mask is eroded by 3 pixels. SAM 2.1 [ 87 ] masks give nearly the same scores (46.0% AP NCD \text{AP}_{\text{NCD}} and 7.3% AP IoU3D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU3D}} , vs. 45.7% and 7.3%). The depth map is predicted at full resolution by the H+ model of Depth Pro 2 [ 55 ] , given the true focal length. We selected this estimator on the validation split among seven monocular depth estimators, including Depth Anything 3 and UniDepthV2, as the one whose median depth in the object mask is most often within 10% of the depth of the ground-truth box center (45% of the objects, vs. 41% for DA3 and 29% for UniDepthV2).

blocks.en: The masked pixels are back-projected with the true intrinsics, points with a depth outside the 5th to 95th percentile of the mask are dropped, and the 3D box is the bounding box of the remaining points along their principal axes. The points cover only the visible surface of the object, so the box leaves out its occluded parts. Its AP NCD \text{AP}_{\text{NCD}} exceeds that of Carbon’s 3D boxes on HOT3D, LM, and IPD but is only 12.5% and 0.0% on T-LESS and ITODD, although its 2D boxes are accurate there (Tab. 3 ).
blocks.zh: 被遮住的像素被背向投射出真实的内在,在遮住的5至95百分位外有深度的分点被投放出,而3D盒则是沿其主轴所剩分点的相接箱. 分数只覆盖物体的可见地表,所以盒子会把被占据的部分留下来. 其AP NDCD\text{AP}_{\text{NCD}}>在HOT3D,LM和IPD上超过了Carbon的3D盒,但在T-LESS和ITODD上只有12.5%和0.0 %,尽管其2D盒是准确的(Tab. 3).

blocks.en: J.5 Off-the-shelf input predictors
blocks.zh: J.5 现成输入预测器

blocks.en: We run SAM 3 [ 14 ] , a text-promptable open-vocabulary segmenter, on each image with the benchmark query, and cache the returned masks, boxes, and confidence scores, keeping detections with a score of at least 0.3 0.3 , the threshold WildDet3D applies to its own text head. SAM 3 returns such a detection for 744 of the 1,400 test queries, and the other 656 queries count as misses for Boxer and SAM 3D in Tabs. 2 and 6 . SAM 3 misses them because it expects short noun phrases rather than full referring expressions.
blocks.zh: 我们运行 SAM 3 [14],一个文本速成的开口-vocabulary分机,每张图像上都有基准查询,并缓存返回的口罩,盒和信心分数,保持检测分数至少为0.3 0.3分,阈值WildDet3D适用于自己的文本头. SAM 3为1400个测试查询中的744个返回了这样的检测,其他656个查询则算作"Boxer"和"SAM 3D"在"Tabs. 2"和"6"中被忽略. SAM 3想念它们,因为它期望的是短名词短语,而不是完全引用表达式.

blocks.en: For the + DA3 and + UniDepthV2 rows, we use the depth-anything/DA3NESTED-GIANT-LARGE checkpoint of Depth Anything 3 [ 65 ] at a processing resolution of 504 pixels and the ViT-L/14 checkpoint lpiccinelli/unidepth-v2-vitl14 of UniDepthV2 [ 81 ] , both conditioned on the camera intrinsics of each image. Both predict metric depth, which we use directly, without scale or shift alignment, and the DA3 depth map is resized bilinearly to the original image resolution.
blocks.zh: 对于+DA3和+Uni DepthV2行,我们使用深度Anything 3[65]的深度-任意/DA3NESTED-GIANT-LARGE检查站,处理分辨率为504像素和Vit-L/14检查站lpicinelli/uni deep-v2-vitl14的Uni DepthV2[81],两者都以每个图像的相机内在为条件. 两者都预测我们直接使用的度量深度,没有尺度或转向对齐,DA3深度图被双线地调整为原始图像分辨率.

blocks.en: Appendix K BOP-Refer vs. Omni3D data distribution
blocks.zh: 附录 K BOP- Refer vs. Omni3D 数据分布

blocks.en: Fig. 3 compares the data distributions of BOP-Refer and Omni3D. The median BOP-Refer object has a volume of 528 ​ cm 3 528\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} (an 8 cm cube), whereas the median Omni3D object has about 1.9 × 10 5 ​ cm 3 1.9\times 10^{5}\,\mathrm{cm}^{3} (furniture and vehicles), roughly 350 × 350\times larger. Likewise, 83.1 % 83.1\% of the Omni3D test annotations lie more than 200 200 cm from the camera but only 0.3 % 0.3\% of the BOP-Refer ones, which concentrate at arm’s length (median depth 76 76 cm). On the image side, Omni3D is dominated by a single focal-length and resolution mode (from Hypersim), whereas BOP-Refer spans the distinct sensors of its nine sources. Its close-up objects come mainly from Objectron [ 2 ] , which covers nine categories and has no referring expressions. The gap may also explain why VLMs whose 3D training data follows the conventions and source datasets of Omni3D, most notably Qwen3-VL [ 7 ] , score high on Omni3D yet transfer poorly to BOP-Refer (Sec. 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 图3比较了BOP-Refer和Omni3D的数据分布. BOP-Refer中位天体的体积为528 cm 3 528\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}(一个8 cm cube),而Omni3D中位天体的体积约为1.9×10 5 cm 3 1.9\tims 10^{5}\,\mathrm{cm}^{3}(家具和车辆),大约为350×350\tims. 同样地,83.1%的Omni3D测试说明离相机200多200厘米,但只有0.3%的BOP-Refer说明,这些说明集中在正常距离(中深76-76厘米)。 在图像方面,Omni3D以单一焦长和分辨率模式为主(来自Hypersim),而BOP-Refer则横跨其9个源的不同传感器. 其特写对象主要出自Objectron [2]. Objectron包含有9个类别,没有参考表达式. 差距还可能说明为什么3D培训数据遵循Omni3D的公约和源数据集的VLM(最显著的是Qune3-VL[7])在Omni3D上得分高而转至BOP-Refer(第4.2条)。

blocks.en: Models trained for an existing monocular 3D grounding benchmark score high on it. On Mono3DRefer [ 99 ] , a KITTI-derived benchmark with the same input-output structure as BOP-Refer, Mono3DVG-EnSD [ 63 ] reaches 69.5 % 69.5\% Acc@0.25. On Omni3D, LocateAnything3D [ 71 ] reaches 38.9 % 38.9\% AP IoU3D \text{AP}_{\text{IoU3D}} , and Qwen3-VL reaches 39.4 % 39.4\% mAP@0.15 on SUN-RGBD, which we reproduced. On BOP-Refer, Qwen3-VL reaches 1.9 % 1.9\% AP IoU3D ​ @0.15 \text{AP}_{\text{IoU3D}}\text{@0.15} (Tab. 10 ).
